text.en:
Section 1 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 1. Any provision of existing law, executive or administrative order, or rule or regulations to the contrary
notwithstanding, the importation, free from customs duties, of gasoline, kerosene, diesels, liquified petroleum
gas, fuel oil, aviation-turbo fuel, aviation gas, NAPHTHA, AND OTHER PROCESSED PRODUCTS AS
MAY BE DETERMINED BY THE PRESIDENT UPON RECOMMENDATION OF THE NATIONAL
ECONOMIC AND DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY by persons or entities duly authorized by the Oil
Industry Commission, shall be allowed for a period of 45 days from the approval of this decree unless sooner
terminated by the President."
Done in the City of Manila, this 26th day of November, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
